record.kind: weather-scoring passive (read by getWeather; no PassiveEffects entry, no combat effect)
record.summary: Passive.DRIZZLE has no PassiveEffects entry and is read in exactly one place: getWeather in app/utils/weather.ts. When the weather for a fight is computed, every unit on the board that is not on row 0 adds +1 to the board score of each of its types that maps to a weather. For a DRIZZLE holder (types WATER and FLYING) the WATER type maps to RAIN, so the holder adds +1 as usual and a further +2 RAIN to the board score and to its own player's score, i.e. 3 in total, which is what the English text 'count as 3 for RAIN' says. The FLYING type adds +1 to WINDY as for any Flying unit. The extra +2 is a score input only: RAIN becomes the fight weather when it is the strictly highest score (a tie for the top gives none) and reaches WeatherThreshold RAIN = 8, otherwise NEUTRAL. The passive itself changes no stat and has no combat effect; weather effects (for example +3 PP per second under RAIN in updateEachSecond) belong to the weather, not to this passive.
triggers: getWeather is called per matchup (PvE and player fights) when the simulations are built; there is no in-fight trigger

effects.declaredRaw: +2 RAIN score in addition to the normal +1 for the WATER type (3 total); +1 WINDY for the FLYING type as for any unit
effects.scaling: none: no stat helper is involved
effects.resolution: added to boardWeatherScore (both players' boards together with weather rocks +3 each) and to the owning board's playerWeatherScore; the dominant weather is the single highest score and is accepted only if its score >= WeatherThreshold[weather] (RAIN: 8), otherwise NEUTRAL. A tie for the highest score yields no dominant weather, hence NEUTRAL. Units on row 0 (positionY == 0) are skipped entirely.

effects.declaredRaw: EffectEnum.DRIZZLE: +8 PP per second, Good Rod (Water synergy tier effect)
effects.scaling: not this passive: the effect is gated on the unit's WATER type through the synergy code, not on entity.passive
effects.resolution: WINGULL and PELIPPER are WATER types so they can also receive EffectEnum.DRIZZLE when the Water synergy tier is reached; that is independent of Passive.DRIZZLE.

conditions: Holder recognised by pkm.passive === Passive.DRIZZLE in the score loop (WINGULL, PELIPPER).
The unit must not be on row 0 (positionY != 0).
The +2 is added only inside the per-type loop when the type's weather is RAIN, i.e. when the unit has the WATER type; both units have it.
The score uses the board Pokémon (getWeather receives the player boards), so it is evaluated before the fight, not during it.
record.resetBehaviour: No state; the score is recomputed every time getWeather is called.
